create_concat_dataset_from_configs: create a ConcatDataset from Hydra DictConfig with multiple dataset splits and sampling strategy
build_concat_dataset_with_sampling: build a ConcatDataset from a dict of datasets using explicit, balanced, temperature, or weighted sampling
get_item_from_concat_dataset: get a data sample by index from a ConcatDataset with automatic dataset and sample index resolution
compute_cumulative_sizes_with_ratios: compute cumulative sizes for datasets using sample ratios to determine effective dataset lengths
get_metadata_for_sample_indices: get natoms metadata for a list of sample indices across multiple concatenated datasets
